# Accept Visa, Mastercard and PayPal payments from international…

> For buyers outside Zimbabwe, WavePay offers Visa and Mastercard through the hosted paynow checkout and PayPal through provider paypal, on the same checkout call — so…

PAYMENT RAIL

# Accept Visa, Mastercard and PayPal payments from international buyers

For buyers outside Zimbabwe, WavePay offers Visa and Mastercard through the hosted paynow checkout and PayPal through provider paypal, on the same checkout call — so one integration serves local and international customers.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth: 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month

## How it works

1. **Same registration.** The merchant key you already have works for every rail.
2. **Pick the provider.** provider "paypal" for PayPal (its checkout also takes Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover and JCB); "paynow" for the hosted checkout that carries Visa and Mastercard alongside the Zimbabwean rails.
3. **Settle in one ledger.** Local and international payments appear in the same ledger, so reconciliation is one feed.

```
curl -sX POST https://t3rnel-wavepay-production.t3ratech.workers.dev/v2/checkouts \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Idempotency-Key: order-1001' \
  -d '{"productId":"your-product","planId":"pro","provider":"paypal","email":"buyer@example.com"}'
```

## Good to know

- A seller in Harare, Nairobi, Lagos or Lisbon uses the same API; the rails offered depend on what the deployment enabled.
- PayPal and PayNow fees are their own.

## Questions

## Can WavePay take international cards?

Yes — Visa and Mastercard are taken through the hosted paynow checkout and through PayPal, which also takes American Express, Discover and JCB.

## Do I need a second integration for PayPal?

No. It is the same POST /v2/checkouts call with provider "paypal".

> To accept EcoCash, register a WavePay merchant, then create a checkout with provider paynow for a hosted page or paynow-mobile with the buyer's phone number to push…

PAYMENT RAIL

# Accept EcoCash payments in your software

To accept EcoCash, register a WavePay merchant, then create a checkout with provider paynow for a hosted page or paynow-mobile with the buyer's phone number to push the EcoCash prompt straight to their handset.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth: 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month

## How it works

1. **Register once.** POST https://t3rnel-wavepay-production.t3ratech.workers.dev/v2/register with a name and ownerEmail. The live key is shown once.
2. **Create the checkout.** Use provider paynow for a hosted checkout URL, or paynow-mobile plus phone for an express wallet push.
3. **Confirm settlement.** Poll GET /v2/checkouts/<reference>/status or receive a signed webhook; a licence key is emailed automatically if licensing is on.

```
curl -sX POST https://t3rnel-wavepay-production.t3ratech.workers.dev/v2/checkouts \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Idempotency-Key: order-1001' \
  -d '{"productId":"your-product","planId":"pro","provider":"paynow-mobile","email":"buyer@example.com","phone":"+2637XXXXXXXX"}'
```

## Good to know

- Express push (paynow-mobile) covers EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks and O'mari; the buyer approves on their handset with their PIN, and the wallet a deployment pushes to is part of its configuration.
- Which rails a deployment enables is reported by GET /v2/providers — check it before showing EcoCash in your UI.
- Provider fees are the provider's own; WavePay takes no percentage of your sales.

## Questions

## Do I need a separate EcoCash merchant integration?

No. WavePay's checkout reaches EcoCash through the same POST /v2/checkouts call you use for every other rail.

## Can I charge an EcoCash user without sending them to a web page?

Yes. Provider paynow-mobile with the buyer's phone number pushes the wallet prompt to the handset.

## Can an agent set EcoCash payments up?

Yes. skill.md and the MCP tool wavepay_checkout cover the full flow with no browser.

# Accept OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch…

> WavePay reaches OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch through the same checkout call as EcoCash — one integration, with GET /v2/providers reporting which…

PAYMENT RAIL

# Accept OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch payments

WavePay reaches OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch through the same checkout call as EcoCash — one integration, with GET /v2/providers reporting which are live on your deployment. OneMoney, InnBucks and O'mari also support wallet push.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth: 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month

## How it works

1. **Ask what is live.** GET /v2/providers returns the rails the deployment has enabled — build your payment picker from it, not from a hard-coded list.
2. **Create the checkout.** POST /v2/checkouts with provider paynow (hosted, all rails) or paynow-mobile (wallet push, EcoCash/OneMoney/InnBucks/O'mari only).
3. **Reconcile.** Every settlement lands in the payments ledger; drain it with POST /v2/internal/payments using since/limit cursors.

```
curl -sX POST https://t3rnel-wavepay-production.t3ratech.workers.dev/v2/checkouts \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Idempotency-Key: order-1001' \
  -d '{"productId":"your-product","planId":"pro","provider":"paynow","email":"buyer@example.com"}'
```

| Rail | Type | How a buyer pays |
| --- | --- | --- |
| EcoCash | Mobile wallet | Hosted checkout, or wallet push with paynow-mobile |
| OneMoney | Mobile wallet | Hosted checkout, or wallet push with paynow-mobile |
| InnBucks | Mobile wallet | Hosted checkout, or wallet push with paynow-mobile |
| Telecash | Mobile wallet | Hosted checkout |
| O'mari | Mobile wallet | Hosted checkout, or wallet push with paynow-mobile |
| ZimSwitch | Local debit-card network | Hosted checkout |

## Good to know

- One integration covers every rail a deployment enables.
- Idempotency-Key makes a retried request return the same checkout instead of a second one.

## Questions

## Which Zimbabwean payment methods does WavePay support?

EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch.

## How do I know which ones are enabled for me?

GET /v2/providers lists the live rails for the deployment you are calling.

## Keep going

- [Accept EcoCash payments in your software](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/accept-ecocash-payments.html)
- [Accept Visa, Mastercard and PayPal payments from international buyers](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/accept-card-and-paypal-payments.html)
- [FAQ](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/faq.html)

وسائل الدفع

## كل وسيلة قد يملكها المشتري

محافظ محلية لزيمبابوي، وبطاقات وPayPal لبقية العالم. تعرض نقطة مزودي الخدمة دائمًا ما هو مفعّل اليوم.

EcoCash OneMoney InnBucks Telecash O'mari ZimSwitch Visa Mastercard PayPal 2Checkout · قريبًا

ما تحصل عليه

## الدفع هو الجزء السهل. وWavePay هو كل ما عداه.

### دفع مُستضاف وطلب على المحفظة

أرسل المشترين إلى صفحة مُستضافة، أو أرسل طلب EcoCash مباشرة إلى هواتفهم.

### تراخيص مدمجة

استحقاقات موقّعة ومفاتيح ترخيص بالبريد وتفعيل للأجهزة واستعادة. يتحقق تطبيقك دون اتصال.

### الاشتراكات والتقسيط

خطط متكررة، واشترِ الآن وادفع لاحقًا بالبطاقة، ومهلة تأخير واضحة قبل انتهاء الوصول.

### المبالغ المستردة والعكس

استرداد كامل أو جزئي عبر المزود، مع سجل بمن أجراه ولماذا.

### بيئة اختبار حقيقية

مفتاح اختبار بجانب مفتاحك الفعلي، ومحاكي، وسفر عبر الزمن لرؤية التجديد يحدث.

### مصمم للوكلاء

skill.md وOpenAPI وخادم MCP وأدوات WebMCP، ليتمكن الذكاء الاصطناعي من إعداد الدفع نيابةً عنك.

كيف يعمل

1

### سجّل

طلب واحد يعيد مفتاحًا فعليًا ومفتاح اختبار. خطة مجانية تعمل فورًا.

2

### بِع

أنشئ عملية دفع واحصل على رابط مُستضاف، أو أرسل طلبًا إلى هاتف.

3

يؤكد webhook موقّع أو استعلام وصول المال. يُرسل مفتاح الترخيص تلقائيًا.

للمطورين

## ابدأ بـ curl. وانتهِ بمفتاح ترخيص.

يُشغَّل كل مثال في الوثائق أولًا في بيئة الاختبار بمفتاح اختبار، فيمكنك التجربة بأمان.

[افتح مرجع الواجهة البرمجية](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html)

curl MCP JavaScript

```
# 1. register: a live key and a test key, shown once 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/register \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"My App","ownerEmail":"you@example.com"}'

# 2. sell: returns a hosted checkout URL 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts \
  -H 'x-wavepay-service-key: mk_test_… ' \
  -H 'idempotency-key: order-1001' \
  -d '{"productId":"my-app","planId":"pro","provider":"paynow","email":"buyer@example.com"}'
```

```
# any MCP client: https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/mcp 
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "wavepay_checkout",
    "arguments": { "productId": "my-app", "planId": "pro",
                   "provider": "paynow", "email": "buyer@example.com" } } }

# tools: wavepay_register, wavepay_providers, wavepay_pricing,
#        wavepay_checkout, wavepay_checkout_status, wavepay_subscribe … 
```

```
const res = await fetch("https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "content-type": "application/json",
    "x-wavepay-service-key": process.env.WAVEPAY_KEY,
    "idempotency-key": crypto.randomUUID(),
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ productId: "my-app", planId: "pro",
                         provider: "paypal", email: "buyer@example.com" }),
});
const { checkoutUrl, reference } = await res.json();
```

أسئلة

## إجابات قبل أن تسأل

ما وسائل الدفع التي يمكنني قبولها؟

EcoCash وOneMoney وInnBucks وTelecash وO'mari وZimSwitch عبر Paynow؛ وVisa وMastercard وPayPal للمشترين الدوليين. 2Checkout جاهز ويُفعَّل عندما يوافق المزود على حسابنا.

هل تأخذون نسبة من مبيعاتي؟

لا. الخطط أسعار شهرية ثابتة بحسب المدفوعات المعالجة. ويفرض مزودو الدفع رسومهم الخاصة.

هل يمكنني الاختبار دون مال حقيقي؟

نعم. يمنحك التسجيل مفتاح اختبار يستخدم محاكيًا. لا يصل إلى أي مزود ولا يُحتسب ضمن خطتك.

كيف يحصل المشترون على ترخيصهم؟

عند تسوية الدفعة ترسل WavePay مفتاح ترخيص بالبريد، ويمكن لتطبيقك التحقق من الاستحقاق الموقّع دون اتصال.

هل يمكن لوكيل ذكاء اصطناعي استخدام WavePay؟

نعم. وجّهه إلى skill.md أو مستند OpenAPI أو خادم MCP. يستطيع الوكيل التسجيل وتحديد الأسعار والتحصيل والمطابقة دون متصفح.

> A card-only processor cannot take a mobile-wallet payment, so buyers who hold EcoCash or OneMoney but not a card cannot pay; WavePay adds those local rails to Visa…

COMPARE

# WavePay vs a card-only payment processor

A card-only processor cannot take a mobile-wallet payment, so buyers who hold EcoCash or OneMoney but not a card cannot pay; WavePay adds those local rails to Visa, Mastercard and PayPal behind the same checkout call.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth: 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month

|  | Card-only processor | WavePay |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Mobile wallets (EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari) | Not offered | Offered; wallet push for EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks and O'mari |
| ZimSwitch | Not offered | Offered |
| Visa / Mastercard / PayPal | Offered | Offered |
| Pricing basis | Typically a percentage of sales | Payments processed: Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth: 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month |
| Self-serve for agents | Varies | POST /v2/register, skill.md, MCP tools |

## Questions

## Why add wallets if cards already work?

Because a buyer without a card cannot pay at all; each extra rail is a set of customers who could not otherwise complete the purchase.

## Is a card-only processor ever the better choice?

Yes, when every buyer you serve holds a card and you need nothing else.

Source: https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/compare-wavepay-vs-integrating-each-rail.html

> Integrating each rail yourself means one integration, one reconciliation feed and one failure mode per wallet and card scheme; WavePay replaces them with one checkout…

COMPARE

# WavePay vs integrating each payment rail yourself

Integrating each rail yourself means one integration, one reconciliation feed and one failure mode per wallet and card scheme; WavePay replaces them with one checkout call and one ledger, at the cost of depending on WavePay for the rails it enables.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth: 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month

|  | Each rail yourself | WavePay |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Integrations to build | One per wallet, card scheme and PayPal | One: POST /v2/checkouts |
| Reconciliation | One report per rail | One payments ledger with since/limit cursors |
| Retries | Each integration's own idempotency rules | Idempotency-Key on every checkout |
| Licence keys | Build and run key issuing yourself | Built in: Ed25519 entitlements, offline verification |
| Agent onboarding | Per-provider portals and forms | POST /v2/register or skill.md — no browser |
| Control | Direct relationship with every provider | WavePay sits between you and the provider |

## Questions

## When should I integrate a rail directly?

When you need one rail only, want the direct provider relationship, and are happy to build its reconciliation and licensing yourself.

## When does WavePay make more sense?

When your buyers hold different rails, or when an agent has to set payments up without a browser.

# WavePay — Zahlungen und Lizenzen für Software

> Nehmen Sie EcoCash, Karten und PayPal mit einer API an. In einer Anfrage registrieren, mit Spielgeld testen und dann mit Lizenzen, Abos und Erstattungen live gehen.

Jetzt mit Abos, Ratenzahlung und 2Checkout

# Lassen Sie sich für Ihre Software bezahlen auf *jedem Weg, den Ihre Kunden nutzen*

Eine API für EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, ZimSwitch, Karten und PayPal. In einer Anfrage registrieren, mit Spielgeld testen und mit eingebauten Lizenzen, Abos und Erstattungen live gehen.

[Kostenlos starten](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/pricing.html#register) [Dokumentation lesen](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html) [Für Agenten](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/skill.md)

- Kostenloser Tarif, keine Karte nötig
- Keine prozentuale Gebühr auf Ihre Umsätze
- REST und MCP

**9**Zahlungsarten

**25**kostenlose Zahlungen pro Monat

**0%**Gebühr auf Ihre Umsätze

**15**Sprachen

Zahlungsarten

## Jede Zahlungsart, die ein Käufer haben könnte

Lokale Wallets für Simbabwe, Karten und PayPal für alle anderen. Der Anbieter-Endpunkt zeigt immer, was heute aktiv ist.

EcoCash OneMoney InnBucks Telecash O'mari ZimSwitch Visa Mastercard PayPal 2Checkout · demnächst

Was Sie bekommen

## Der Checkout ist der leichte Teil. WavePay ist der Rest.

### Gehosteter Checkout und Wallet-Anfrage

Schicken Sie Käufer auf eine gehostete Seite oder senden Sie eine EcoCash-Anfrage direkt aufs Handy.

### Lizenzierung eingebaut

Signierte Berechtigungen, Lizenzschlüssel per E-Mail, Geräteaktivierung und Wiederherstellung. Ihre App prüft offline.

### Abos und Ratenzahlung

Wiederkehrende Pläne, Kartenzahlung später und eine klare Verzugsfrist, bevor der Zugang endet.

### Erstattungen und Rückbuchungen

Volle und teilweise Erstattungen über den Anbieter, mit Nachweis, wer sie warum veranlasst hat.

### Eine echte Testumgebung

Ein Testschlüssel neben Ihrem Live-Schlüssel, ein Simulator und Zeitreise, um eine Verlängerung zu beobachten.

### Für Agenten gebaut

skill.md, OpenAPI, ein MCP-Server und WebMCP-Werkzeuge: Eine KI kann den Checkout für Sie einrichten.

So funktioniert es

## Drei Anfragen von null bis bezahlt

1

### Registrieren

Eine Anfrage liefert einen Live- und einen Testschlüssel. Kostenloser Tarif, sofort aktiv.

2

### Verkaufen

Erstellen Sie einen Checkout und erhalten Sie eine gehostete URL oder senden Sie eine Wallet-Anfrage ans Handy.

3

### Abwickeln

Ein signierter Webhook oder eine Abfrage bestätigt das Geld. Der Lizenzschlüssel geht automatisch per E-Mail raus.

Für Entwickler

## Mit curl anfangen. Mit einem Lizenzschlüssel enden.

Jedes Beispiel der Dokumentation läuft zuerst mit einem Testschlüssel in der Sandbox, damit Sie gefahrlos ausprobieren können.

[API-Referenz öffnen](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html)

curl MCP JavaScript

```
# 1. register: a live key and a test key, shown once 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/register \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"My App","ownerEmail":"you@example.com"}'

# 2. sell: returns a hosted checkout URL 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts \
  -H 'x-wavepay-service-key: mk_test_… ' \
  -H 'idempotency-key: order-1001' \
  -d '{"productId":"my-app","planId":"pro","provider":"paynow","email":"buyer@example.com"}'
```

```
# any MCP client: https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/mcp 
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "wavepay_checkout",
    "arguments": { "productId": "my-app", "planId": "pro",
                   "provider": "paynow", "email": "buyer@example.com" } } }

# tools: wavepay_register, wavepay_providers, wavepay_pricing,
#        wavepay_checkout, wavepay_checkout_status, wavepay_subscribe … 
```

```
const res = await fetch("https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "content-type": "application/json",
    "x-wavepay-service-key": process.env.WAVEPAY_KEY,
    "idempotency-key": crypto.randomUUID(),
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ productId: "my-app", planId: "pro",
                         provider: "paypal", email: "buyer@example.com" }),
});
const { checkoutUrl, reference } = await res.json();
```

Fragen

## Antworten, bevor Sie fragen

Welche Zahlungsarten kann ich annehmen?

EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari und ZimSwitch über Paynow; Visa, Mastercard und PayPal für internationale Käufer. 2Checkout ist gebaut und wird aktiviert, sobald der Anbieter unser Konto freigibt.

Nehmen Sie einen Prozentsatz meiner Umsätze?

Nein. Die Pläne sind feste Monatspreise nach verarbeiteten Zahlungen. Die Zahlungsanbieter berechnen ihre eigenen Gebühren.

Kann ich ohne echtes Geld testen?

Ja. Die Registrierung gibt Ihnen einen Testschlüssel mit Simulator. Er erreicht nie einen Anbieter und zählt nicht auf Ihren Plan.

Wie erhalten Käufer ihre Lizenz?

Sobald eine Zahlung abgewickelt ist, sendet WavePay einen Lizenzschlüssel per E-Mail, und Ihre App kann die signierte Berechtigung offline prüfen.

Kann ein KI-Agent WavePay nutzen?

Ja. Verweisen Sie ihn auf skill.md, das OpenAPI-Dokument oder den MCP-Server. Ein Agent kann sich registrieren, Preise setzen, kassieren und abgleichen, ganz ohne Browser.

# Docs — WavePay

> WavePay developer documentation: merchant registration, checkouts on every rail, wallet push, licensing, webhooks, the payments ledger and MCP tools for agents.

Developer docs

# The whole API in one page

Base URL: `https://t3rnel-wavepay-production.t3ratech.workers.dev`. Public endpoints are rate-limited per client. Merchant endpoints take your key in the `x-wavepay-service-key` header. Agents: [skill.md](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/skill.md) is the same reference shaped for autonomous clients; `POST /mcp` speaks JSON-RPC tools.

### 0 · Register — no browser

```
POST /v2/register
{ "name": "My Product", "ownerEmail": "you@x.com" }
// 201 → { "merchantId": "mer_…", "key": "mk_live_…",
//         "planId": "free", "paymentsPerMonth": 25 }
// The key is shown once — only its hash is stored.
```

One registration per email; 5/day per client. A lost key is re-minted by the operator against the owner email.

### 1 · Start a checkout

```
POST /v2/checkouts
Idempotency-Key: <stable per order>
{
  "productId": "your-product",
  "planId": "pro",
  "provider": "paynow",        // "paynow-mobile" | "paypal"
  "email": "buyer@x.com",
  "phone": "+2637…"            // express wallet push only
}
// 201 → { "checkoutUrl": "…", "reference": "pay_…" }
```

Hand the buyer `checkoutUrl`. With `paynow-mobile` + `phone`, the wallet prompt pushes straight to the handset — no page at all.

### 2 · Watch it settle

```
GET /v2/checkouts/<reference>/status
// 200 → { "status": "pending" | "collected" | "expired" }

// settlement push instead — register a webhook on your site:
POST /v2/internal/sites/webhook
x-wavepay-service-key: mk_live_…
{ "siteId": "…", "url": "https://you.dev/hook" }
// → returns the HMAC secret once; settlements sign with it.
```

### 3 · Catalogue and pricing

```
GET /v2/providers                   // live rails
GET /v2/pricing?productId=…         // plans, prices, promotions

GET /v2/internal/merchant/catalog   // with your key —
// the sites, plans and coupons your merchant sees
```

### MCP — tools for agents

```
POST /mcp                       // JSON-RPC 2.0
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}
// wavepay_register · wavepay_providers · wavepay_pricing
// wavepay_checkout · wavepay_checkout_status · wavepay_catalog
// Merchant tools read the key from the request's
// x-wavepay-service-key header, same as REST.
```

### Licensing (optional, built in)

```
POST /v2/licensing/checkout    // sells + emails a licence key
POST /v2/licensing/activate    // { "licenseKey", "deviceId" } → signed entitlement
POST /v2/licensing/recover     // mails the buyer a fresh key
GET  /v2/licensing/public-key  // Ed25519 trust root — verify entitlements offline
```

T3rnel Browser sells Pro on this exact flow in production.

### Merchant endpoints

| Endpoint | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /v2/internal/payments` | Your settlement ledger — idempotent drain with `since`/`limit` cursors |
| `POST /v2/internal/coupons/mint` | Mint discount codes on your products (Basic+) |
| `GET /v2/internal/merchant/catalog` | Everything your key can sell: sites, plans, live prices |
| `GET/PUT/DELETE /v2/internal/merchant/settlement[/{provider}]` | Connect your own PayPal account so payments land with you; credentials are checked, sealed and never returned |
| `GET /v2/price-list` | WavePay's own price list: plans, usage schedule, modes (also [/pricing.json](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/pricing.json)) |
| `GET /v2/internal/merchant/usage` | Your usage meter for the month and the total due |
| `POST /v2/internal/sites/webhook` | Set the settlement webhook for a site (secret returned once) |
| `POST /v2/test/settle` | Test-mode settlement — exercise the webhook end-to-end, no money moves |
| `POST /v2/test/billing/run` | Test key only — run the billing engine as if `advanceDays` had passed, to exercise renewals, instalments and dunning |
| `GET /v2/features` | Which flagged capabilities are on for live money (test keys can use all of them) |
| `POST /v2/internal/subscriptions` | Open a subscription (needs `Idempotency-Key`); `GET` lists, `/cancel` ends |
| `POST /v2/internal/bnpl` | Buy now, pay later on a card: deposit now, instalments until the total is paid |
| `POST /v2/internal/refunds` | Refund a settled PayPal or test payment, in part or in full |
| `POST /v2/internal/subscriptions/pause` | Pause a subscription (also at 2Checkout); `/resume` undoes it, `/price` changes the renewal price |
| `POST /v2/twocheckout/ipn` | 2Checkout's signed order, renewal, refund and chargeback notifications (and `/lcn` for subscription changes) — called by 2Checkout, not by you |
| `POST /v2/internal/checkouts/otp` | Complete an O'mari payment with the buyer's one-time PIN |

### Test mode

`POST /v2/register` returns `key` (`mk_live_…`) and `testKey` (`mk_test_…`). A test key calls the same routes but settles through a simulator that never contacts a provider and never counts against your cap. Choose the outcome with Paynow's test phones: `0771111111` paid, `0772222222` paid after ten seconds, `0773333333` cancelled, `0774444444` failed; or tag the email (`+decline`, `+cancel`, `+delay`). A test checkout's URL is a hosted page with Approve and Decline buttons. Read [the test-mode guide](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/guide-test-mode.html).

### Subscriptions, instalments and refunds

**Automatic** collection charges a saved card (Paynow card tokens, once Paynow has approved them for the deployment) or a PayPal subscription. **invoice_and_remind** sends a payment request each period and is the only mode for EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks and O'mari, which cannot be debited unattended. **BNPL** takes a deposit and collects the rest from a non-prepaid card until the total is paid; WavePay collects, it does not lend. **Refunds** work for PayPal and test payments; Paynow documents no refund API. These are switched on per deployment — check `GET /v2/features`. See [recurring payments](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/guide-recurring-payments.html) and [buy now, pay later](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/guide-buy-now-pay-later.html).

### Rails and rules

**paynow** — hosted PayNow checkout: Visa, Mastercard, ZimSwitch, EcoCash, OneMoney, Telecash, InnBucks, O'mari. **paynow-mobile** — express wallet push to a phone. **twocheckout** — Verifone's 2Checkout: international cards and PayPal, merchant of record, 2Checkout-billed subscriptions, refunds, signed IPN/LCN notifications. **paypal** — international buyers, USD. Prices are minor units (900 = $9.00). Free tier caps at 25 payments/30 days — the cap refuses checkouts as `MERCHANT_LIMIT_REACHED`, never mid-payment. Idempotency-Key retries return the same checkout; `mk_test_…` keys run every route with fake money.


---

Source: https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/es/

# WavePay — pagos y licencias para software

> Acepta EcoCash, tarjetas y PayPal con una sola API. Regístrate en una solicitud, prueba con dinero ficticio y pasa a producción con licencias, suscripciones y reembolsos.

Ahora con suscripciones, pagos a plazos y 2Checkout

# Cobra por tu software en *todos los medios de pago que usan tus clientes*

Una API para EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, ZimSwitch, tarjetas y PayPal. Regístrate en una solicitud, prueba con dinero ficticio y pasa a producción con licencias, suscripciones y reembolsos incluidos.

[Empieza gratis](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/pricing.html#register) [Leer la documentación](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html) [Para agentes](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/skill.md)

- Plan gratuito, sin tarjeta
- Sin comisión sobre tus ventas
- REST y MCP

**9**medios de pago

**25**pagos gratis al mes

**0%**de comisión sobre tus ventas

**15**idiomas

Medios de pago

## Todos los medios que un comprador puede tener

Carteras móviles locales para Zimbabue, tarjetas y PayPal para el resto. El punto de acceso de proveedores siempre indica qué está activo hoy.

EcoCash OneMoney InnBucks Telecash O'mari ZimSwitch Visa Mastercard PayPal 2Checkout · próximamente

Qué obtienes

## Cobrar es la parte fácil. WavePay es el resto.

### Pago alojado y solicitud a la cartera

Envía a los compradores a una página alojada o lanza una solicitud de EcoCash directamente a su teléfono.

### Licencias integradas

Derechos firmados, claves de licencia por correo, activación de dispositivos y recuperación. Tu aplicación verifica sin conexión.

### Suscripciones y pagos a plazos

Planes recurrentes, compra ahora y paga después con tarjeta, y un plazo claro de demora antes de que termine el acceso.

### Reembolsos y reversiones

Reembolsos totales o parciales a través del proveedor, con constancia de quién lo hizo y por qué.

### Un entorno de pruebas real

Una clave de prueba junto a tu clave real, un simulador y viaje en el tiempo para ver una renovación.

### Hecho para agentes

skill.md, OpenAPI, un servidor MCP y herramientas WebMCP: una IA puede configurar el pago por ti.

Cómo funciona

## Tres solicitudes de cero a cobrado

1

### Registrarte

Una solicitud devuelve una clave real y una clave de prueba. Plan gratuito, activo al instante.

2

### Vender

Crea un pago y obtén una URL alojada, o lanza una solicitud a un teléfono.

3

### Liquidar

Un webhook firmado o una consulta confirma el dinero. La clave de licencia se envía sola.

```
# 1. register: a live key and a test key, shown once

  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"My App","ownerEmail":"you@example.com"}'

# 2. sell: returns a hosted checkout URL 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts \
  -H 'x-wavepay-service-key: mk_test_… ' \
  -H 'idempotency-key: order-1001' \
  -d '{"productId":"my-app","planId":"pro","provider":"paynow","email":"buyer@example.com"}'
```

```
# any MCP client: https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/mcp 
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "wavepay_checkout",
    "arguments": { "productId": "my-app", "planId": "pro",
                   "provider": "paynow", "email": "buyer@example.com" } } }

# tools: wavepay_register, wavepay_providers, wavepay_pricing,
#        wavepay_checkout, wavepay_checkout_status, wavepay_subscribe … 
```

```
const res = await fetch("https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "content-type": "application/json",

  body: JSON.stringify({ productId: "my-app", planId: "pro",
                         provider: "paypal", email: "buyer@example.com" }),
});

```

Preguntas

## Respuestas antes de que preguntes

¿Qué medios de pago puedo aceptar?

EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari y ZimSwitch mediante Paynow; Visa, Mastercard y PayPal para compradores internacionales. 2Checkout está construido y se activa cuando el proveedor apruebe nuestra cuenta.

¿Cobráis un porcentaje de mis ventas?

No. Los planes son precios mensuales fijos según los pagos procesados. Los proveedores de pago cobran sus propias tarifas.

¿Puedo probar sin dinero real?

Sí. El registro te da una clave de prueba que usa un simulador. Nunca llega a un proveedor y no cuenta para tu plan.

¿Cómo reciben los compradores su licencia?

Cuando un pago se liquida, WavePay envía una clave de licencia por correo y tu aplicación puede verificar el derecho firmado sin conexión.

¿Puede un agente de IA usar WavePay?

Sí. Indícale skill.md, el documento OpenAPI o el servidor MCP. Un agente puede registrarse, fijar precios, cobrar y conciliar sin navegador.

# WavePay FAQ · WavePay

> WavePay is the checkout, licensing and settlement API for software — apps, browser extensions, games, APIs and bots.

QUESTIONS

# Frequently asked questions

WavePay is the checkout, licensing and settlement API for software — apps, browser extensions, games, APIs and bots. One integration reaches Zimbabwean wallets (EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari, ZimSwitch) and international rails (Visa, Mastercard, PayPal).

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth: 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month

## What is WavePay?

WavePay is the checkout, licensing and settlement API for software — apps, browser extensions, games, APIs and bots. One integration reaches Zimbabwean wallets (EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari, ZimSwitch) and international rails (Visa, Mastercard, PayPal).

## How do I start accepting payments?

Two calls. POST /v2/register with a name and an email returns a live merchant key (mk_live_…) once; POST /v2/checkouts with that product and plan returns a hosted checkout URL. The free tier works immediately — 25 payments per 30 days.

## Does WavePay take a percentage of my sales?

Only after your plan's included payments, and the percentage falls as your volume grows (2% down to 0.4%, with a small minimum per payment). The plan fee covers the software: Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth: 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month. Provider fees are paid to the provider at cost with no WavePay markup. Full schedule: /pricing.html and /pricing.json.

## Which payment methods can my customers use?

EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch for Zimbabwean buyers; Visa, Mastercard and PayPal for international buyers. Which are enabled on a deployment is reported live by GET /v2/providers.

## Can an AI agent set up and run payments by itself?

Yes. skill.md is the whole onboarding in one markdown file, and POST /mcp exposes JSON-RPC tools (wavepay_register, wavepay_providers, wavepay_pricing, wavepay_checkout, wavepay_checkout_status, wavepay_catalog). No browser, OAuth or email round-trip is needed.

## How do I know a payment landed?

Poll GET /v2/checkouts/<reference>/status (pending, collected or expired) or register a signed webhook. Every settlement is also in the payments ledger, which you can drain idempotently with since/limit cursors.

## Can a retry charge a customer twice?

No. POST /v2/checkouts takes an Idempotency-Key; repeating a request with the same key returns the same checkout instead of creating a second one.

## Does WavePay issue licence keys?

Yes. Licensing is built in: a paid checkout emails a licence key, devices activate it for an Ed25519-signed entitlement, and your app verifies that entitlement offline against the public key at GET /v2/licensing/public-key.

## Can I charge someone without a browser?

Yes, for EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks and O'mari: use provider paynow-mobile with the buyer's phone number and the wallet prompt is pushed straight to the handset to approve with a PIN. The wallet a deployment pushes to is part of its configuration — GET /v2/providers shows it. Games and bots, where a hosted page cannot open, use this.

## Can I test without moving money?

Yes. POST /v2/register returns a test key (mk_test_…) beside your live one. A test key uses the same routes, settles through a simulator that never contacts a provider, and never counts against your payment cap. Paynow's own test phone numbers choose the outcome: 0771111111 pays, 0772222222 pays after ten seconds, 0773333333 cancels, 0774444444 fails. POST /v2/test/billing/run advances time so renewals and instalments can be tested without waiting, and POST /v2/test/settle exercises your webhook end to end.

## Can I charge customers every month?

Yes, as subscriptions. A saved card (where Paynow has approved card tokens for the deployment) or a PayPal subscription is charged automatically. EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks and O'mari cannot be debited without the customer, so each period the customer is sent a fresh payment prompt and their access follows what they actually pay. GET /v2/features reports which of these a deployment has switched on for live money; a test key can use all of them today.

## Can customers buy now and pay later?

Yes, on cards. The customer pays a deposit, the rest is collected from that card on a schedule, and collection continues until the total is paid. Prepaid cards and virtual cards are refused because they can be emptied or closed after delivery. WavePay collects; it does not lend, so the merchant carries the risk that a card stops working, which is why access is suspended after a grace period of missed payments and restored when payment resumes. Mobile wallets are not offered BNPL because they cannot be debited unattended.

## Does WavePay work with 2Checkout (Verifone)?

Yes. Provider twocheckout is Verifone's 2Checkout: international cards and PayPal with 2Checkout as merchant of record, so it handles tax and invoicing. A one-time checkout is a signed 2Checkout link settled by signed IPN; a subscription with collection=automatic is billed by 2Checkout itself, and WavePay records each renewal, refund and chargeback from its signed notifications. GET /v2/providers lists it wherever it is enabled.

## Can I refund a payment?

Yes for PayPal payments and for test payments: POST /v2/internal/refunds with an Idempotency-Key refunds all or part of a settled payment, never more than was paid. Paynow documents no refund API, so a Paynow payment is refused with REFUND_UNSUPPORTED rather than recorded as refunded; refund those from the Paynow dashboard.

## What happens when I hit my plan's payment cap?

New checkouts are refused with MERCHANT_LIMIT_REACHED. A buyer who is already mid-payment is never blocked or double-charged.

## Who runs WavePay?

WavePay is built by T3raTech (TeraTech Solutions (Private) Limited). T3rnel Browser sells its Pro tier on this rail in production.

Moyens de paiement

## Tous les moyens que vos clients possèdent

Portefeuilles mobiles locaux pour le Zimbabwe, cartes et PayPal pour les autres. Le point d'accès des fournisseurs indique toujours ce qui est actif aujourd'hui.

EcoCash OneMoney InnBucks Telecash O'mari ZimSwitch Visa Mastercard PayPal 2Checkout · bientôt

Ce que vous obtenez

## Le paiement est la partie facile. WavePay s'occupe du reste.

### Paiement hébergé et demande mobile

Envoyez vos clients vers une page hébergée, ou déclenchez une demande EcoCash directement sur leur téléphone.

### Licences intégrées

Droits signés, clés de licence par e-mail, activation d'appareils et récupération. Votre application vérifie hors ligne.

Formules récurrentes, payer plus tard par carte, et un délai de retard clair avant la fin de l'accès.

```
# 1. register: a live key and a test key, shown once
```

```
# any MCP client: https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/mcp 
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
```

```
const res = await fetch("https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "content-type": "application/json",

    "idempotency-key": crypto.randomUUID(),

                         provider: "paypal", email: "buyer@example.com" }),

const { checkoutUrl, reference } = await res.json();
```

Questions

## Les réponses avant la question

Quels moyens de paiement puis-je accepter ?

EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari et ZimSwitch via Paynow ; Visa, Mastercard et PayPal pour les acheteurs internationaux. 2Checkout est prêt et sera activé dès que le fournisseur approuvera notre compte.

Prélevez-vous un pourcentage sur mes ventes ?

Non. Les forfaits sont des prix mensuels fixes selon le nombre de paiements traités. Les fournisseurs de paiement facturent leurs propres frais.

Puis-je tester sans argent réel ?

Oui. L'inscription vous donne une clé de test qui utilise un simulateur. Elle n'atteint jamais un fournisseur et ne compte pas dans votre forfait.

Comment les acheteurs reçoivent-ils leur licence ?

Quand un paiement est réglé, WavePay envoie une clé de licence par e-mail, et votre application peut vérifier hors ligne le droit signé.

Un agent IA peut-il utiliser WavePay ?

Oui. Indiquez-lui skill.md, le document OpenAPI ou le serveur MCP. Un agent peut s'inscrire, fixer les prix, encaisser et rapprocher sans navigateur.

# 2Checkout (Verifone) with WavePay: checkout, subscriptions…

> WavePay sells through 2Checkout as provider twocheckout: a signed buy-link for one-time purchases, 2Checkout-billed subscriptions with every renewal recorded from a…

HOW IT WORKS

# 2Checkout (Verifone) with WavePay: checkout, subscriptions, refunds and notifications

WavePay sells through 2Checkout as provider twocheckout: a signed buy-link for one-time purchases, 2Checkout-billed subscriptions with every renewal recorded from a signed notification, refunds through its REST API, and HMAC-signed IPN and LCN webhooks, with 2Checkout acting as merchant of record for tax and invoicing.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth: 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month

## One-time checkout

POST /v2/checkouts with provider twocheckout returns a link signed with your buy-link secret word. The price, currency, reference and a 24-hour expiry are inside the signature, so none can be edited in the URL. Settlement is proven by the signed IPN or the REST order lookup, never by the redirect alone.

## Subscriptions billed by 2Checkout

Create a subscription with collection=automatic and 2Checkout bills every renewal itself: the period and renewal price travel in the signed link. WavePay extends access by exactly one period when the renewal notification arrives, ignores a resent notification, and never raises its own charge on top. A late renewal marks the subscription past due after three days and ends it after ten.

## Cancel, pause and change the price

Cancel now disables the subscription at 2Checkout; cancel at period end switches renewal off and keeps the paid access. Pause stops the next renewal until you resume it. Price changes what the next renewals cost. Each is applied at 2Checkout first, then recorded here.

## Refunds and chargebacks

POST /v2/internal/refunds refunds a completed order through 2Checkout's REST API, in part or in full, within three months. A refund issued in the 2Checkout dashboard arrives as a notification and is recorded once. A chargeback is recorded for you to see; it never silently refunds or revokes.

## Signed notifications

2Checkout posts IPN (orders, renewals, refunds, reversals, chargebacks) and LCN (subscription changes). Both are checked against an HMAC-SHA256 of the received values before anything happens, and answered with the signed receipt 2Checkout waits for. A notification for an order WavePay did not create is acknowledged and ignored.

## Test orders

Staging places 2Checkout links as test orders: use card 4111111111111111 with any expiry and CVV, and choose the outcome by cardholder name (John Doe succeeds; Mona Doe fails for insufficient funds). A deployment that takes live orders ignores test-order notifications, so a dummy card can never grant a licence.

## Switching it on

The 2Checkout rail is a configuration switch, not a code change: a deployment lists twocheckout in its enabled providers once the account is approved, and GET /v2/providers then offers it to buyers.

# Buy now, pay later for software: deposits and instalments on…

> WavePay BNPL takes a deposit at checkout and collects the rest from the customer's card on a schedule, retrying with a back-off until the full price is paid; it is…

HOW IT WORKS

# Buy now, pay later for software: deposits and instalments on cards

WavePay BNPL takes a deposit at checkout and collects the rest from the customer's card on a schedule, retrying with a back-off until the full price is paid; it is limited to non-prepaid cards, and WavePay collects but does not lend.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth: 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month

## How a plan runs

POST /v2/internal/bnpl with the number of instalments. The customer pays the deposit and their card is saved. Each interval the next instalment is charged; the last one is only what remains. When paid equals the price the plan completes and stops charging.

## Collection never gives up

A failed instalment is retried after one day, then two, then every three days, with no limit on attempts, until the total is collected or the merchant cancels the plan.

## Which cards

Cards only: provider paynow (Visa, Mastercard, ZimSwitch) or paypal (a vaulted card). Prepaid cards and virtual cards, including mobile-money virtual cards, are refused because they can be emptied or closed after delivery. A card is refused if the issuer reports it prepaid, if its first six digits fall in a range the operator has blocked, or if it cannot be screened at all.

## A refused card

The plan is cancelled and access withdrawn. The deposit is refunded automatically where the provider has a refund API (PayPal); for Paynow, which documents none, the plan's audit record is marked needsRefund so the merchant returns it.

## Access while overdue

Access is suspended after the grace period of missed payments (14 days by default) and restored by the next successful payment. Instalments settle money; they do not extend the access the deposit granted.

## Who carries the risk

The merchant. WavePay is a collection schedule, not a lender: it does not advance the merchant the balance. A card that stops working leaves the instalments unpaid, which is why access follows payment. Confirm that selling on instalments is permitted for your business and customers before you offer it.

> Send a stable Idempotency-Key with every POST /v2/checkouts — derived from your order id, not generated per attempt — and a retry after a timeout returns the original…

HOW IT WORKS

# Idempotent checkouts: why a retry should never charge twice

Send a stable Idempotency-Key with every POST /v2/checkouts — derived from your order id, not generated per attempt — and a retry after a timeout returns the original checkout instead of creating a second charge.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth: 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month

## The failure it prevents

A request times out and the client cannot tell whether the checkout was created. Without a key the safe-looking retry creates a second checkout and can charge the buyer twice.

## Choosing the key

Use something stable per order, such as order-1001. A random value per attempt defeats the point: each retry would look like a new request.

## Where it applies

Every checkout, hosted or wallet push. Settlement polling and webhooks are reads and need no key.

## Reconciling

Match on the checkout reference (pay_…) that comes back; the ledger holds one row per settlement.

- [2Checkout (Verifone) with WavePay: checkout, subscriptions, refunds and notifications](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/guide-2checkout.html)

Source: https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/guide-offline-licence-verification.html

> WavePay signs each licence entitlement with an Ed25519 private key it never shares, so your app verifies the signature offline against the public key at GET…

HOW IT WORKS

# How offline licence verification works with Ed25519 entitlements

WavePay signs each licence entitlement with an Ed25519 private key it never shares, so your app verifies the signature offline against the public key at GET /v2/licensing/public-key and never needs to call a server to know a licence is genuine.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth: 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month

## The flow

A paid checkout emails a licence key. The device calls POST /v2/licensing/activate with the key and a deviceId and receives a signed entitlement. The app stores it and checks the signature locally.

## Why Ed25519

Verification needs only the public key, which is safe to embed in the app. Forging an entitlement requires the private key, which stays with the issuer.

## What this buys you

An app that works offline, no per-launch licence call to fail, and a trust root you can pin. When a customer loses a key, POST /v2/licensing/recover mails a fresh one.

## What it does not do

An offline check cannot know a licence was revoked after the entitlement was issued; design entitlement lifetimes to match how quickly you need revocation to bite.

# Recurring payments in Zimbabwe: what charges automatically and…

> A card token or a PayPal subscription can be charged every period with nobody present, but mobile wallets such as EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks and O'mari cannot be…

HOW IT WORKS

# Recurring payments in Zimbabwe: what charges automatically and what cannot

A card token or a PayPal subscription can be charged every period with nobody present, but mobile wallets such as EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks and O'mari cannot be debited unattended, so a WavePay subscription on a wallet sends the customer a fresh payment prompt each period and access follows what they pay.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth: 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month

## Two collection modes

automatic charges a saved instrument: a Paynow card token (Visa, Mastercard or ZimSwitch) or a PayPal subscription. invoice_and_remind raises a normal checkout each period, pushes the wallet prompt or sends a link, and extends access when it is paid. It is the only mode that works on every local rail.

## Why wallets are different

Paynow documents tokens for cards only. A wallet payment needs the customer's PIN every time, so no service can charge it silently. WavePay does not pretend otherwise: it asks each period.

## Paynow card tokens need Paynow's approval

A merchant may only tokenise cards once Paynow has enabled it for the integration. If a subscription asks for automatic collection and no token comes back, it falls back to invoice_and_remind and records why, instead of failing.

## Failed payments

A failed charge is retried the next day, then two days later. Three failures make the subscription past due, and a week after the first failed attempt it ends. A card whose token has expired is replaced by a payment request, and the customer is told.

## Cancelling

POST /v2/internal/subscriptions/cancel ends it now, or with atPeriodEnd true keeps access to the end of the paid period. A PayPal subscription is also cancelled at PayPal.

## Idempotent

Creating a subscription needs an Idempotency-Key, and every renewal is keyed by its period and attempt, so a repeated billing run can never charge a period twice.

# Testing WavePay with fake money: test keys, simulated outcomes…

> POST /v2/register returns a live key and a test key (mk_test_…); the test key calls the same routes but settles through a simulator that never contacts a payment…

HOW IT WORKS

# Testing WavePay with fake money: test keys, simulated outcomes and time travel

POST /v2/register returns a live key and a test key (mk_test_…); the test key calls the same routes but settles through a simulator that never contacts a payment provider, so you can drive every outcome of your integration, including renewals and instalments, without moving money.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth: 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month

## Getting a test key

Registration returns key (mk_live_…) and testKey (mk_test_…) together, both shown once. Send either in the x-wavepay-service-key header. A test key never counts against your plan's payment cap.

## Choosing the outcome

Use Paynow's own test phone numbers: 0771111111 pays, 0772222222 pays after ten seconds, 0773333333 is cancelled by the customer, 0774444444 fails for insufficient balance. Without a phone, tag the email: buyer+decline@example.com fails, +cancel cancels, +delay pays after ten seconds. For card tokens, +prepaid returns a prepaid card (BNPL refuses it) and +tokdecline returns a token whose later charges are declined.

## Hosted pages

A test checkout's checkoutUrl is a WavePay page with Approve and Decline buttons, so the redirect-and-return leg of your integration can be walked end to end. It only ever acts on test payments.

## Time travel

POST /v2/test/billing/run with {"advanceDays": 31} runs the billing engine as if 31 days had passed, once for your test subscriptions and instalment plans only. Run it again to reconcile the charges it raised.

## Features that are not yet live

Subscriptions, BNPL, refunds and card tokens are switched on per deployment. A test key can use every one of them regardless, which is how you build against them before they are enabled for live money. GET /v2/features reports the live state.

## What a test key does not prove

A simulator proves your integration handles every outcome; it does not prove a provider's behaviour. Run one live payment of the smallest amount before launch.

## हर वह माध्यम जो खरीदार के पास हो सकता है

ज़िम्बाब्वे के लिए स्थानीय वॉलेट, बाकी दुनिया के लिए कार्ड और PayPal। प्रदाता एंडपॉइंट हमेशा बताता है कि आज क्या चालू है।

EcoCash OneMoney InnBucks Telecash O'mari ZimSwitch Visa Mastercard PayPal 2Checkout · जल्द आ रहा है

आपको क्या मिलता है

## चेकआउट आसान हिस्सा है। बाकी सब WavePay है।

### होस्टेड चेकआउट और वॉलेट पुश

खरीदारों को होस्टेड पेज पर भेजें, या EcoCash अनुरोध सीधे उनके फ़ोन पर भेजें।

### लाइसेंसिंग अंतर्निहित

हस्ताक्षरित अधिकार, ईमेल से लाइसेंस कुंजी, डिवाइस सक्रियण और पुनर्प्राप्ति। आपका ऐप ऑफ़लाइन सत्यापित करता है।

### सदस्यता और किस्तें

आवर्ती योजनाएँ, कार्ड पर अभी खरीदें बाद में भुगतान करें, और पहुँच समाप्त होने से पहले स्पष्ट विलंब अवधि।

### रिफ़ंड और उलटाव

प्रदाता के माध्यम से पूर्ण और आंशिक रिफ़ंड, किसने और क्यों किया इसके रिकॉर्ड के साथ।

### असली परीक्षण वातावरण

आपकी लाइव कुंजी के साथ एक परीक्षण कुंजी, एक सिम्युलेटर, और नवीनीकरण होते देखने के लिए समय यात्रा।

### एजेंटों के लिए बना

skill.md, OpenAPI, एक MCP सर्वर और WebMCP टूल, ताकि AI आपके लिए चेकआउट सेट कर सके।

यह कैसे काम करता है

## शून्य से भुगतान तक तीन अनुरोध

1

### पंजीकरण

एक अनुरोध लाइव कुंजी और परीक्षण कुंजी लौटाता है। मुफ़्त योजना, तुरंत चालू।

2

### बिक्री

चेकआउट बनाएँ और होस्टेड URL पाएँ, या फ़ोन पर वॉलेट अनुरोध भेजें।

3

### निपटान

हस्ताक्षरित वेबहुक या पोल पैसे की पुष्टि करता है। लाइसेंस कुंजी अपने आप ईमेल हो जाती है।

डेवलपरों के लिए

## curl से शुरू करें। लाइसेंस कुंजी पर खत्म करें।

दस्तावेज़ का हर उदाहरण पहले परीक्षण कुंजी के साथ सैंडबॉक्स में चलता है, ताकि आप सुरक्षित रूप से प्रयोग कर सकें।

[API संदर्भ खोलें](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html)

curl MCP JavaScript

```
# 1. register: a live key and a test key, shown once 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/register \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"My App","ownerEmail":"you@example.com"}'

# 2. sell: returns a hosted checkout URL 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts \
  -H 'x-wavepay-service-key: mk_test_… ' \
  -H 'idempotency-key: order-1001' \
  -d '{"productId":"my-app","planId":"pro","provider":"paynow","email":"buyer@example.com"}'
```

```
# any MCP client: https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/mcp 
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "wavepay_checkout",
    "arguments": { "productId": "my-app", "planId": "pro",
                   "provider": "paynow", "email": "buyer@example.com" } } }

# tools: wavepay_register, wavepay_providers, wavepay_pricing,
#        wavepay_checkout, wavepay_checkout_status, wavepay_subscribe … 
```

```
const res = await fetch("https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "content-type": "application/json",
    "x-wavepay-service-key": process.env.WAVEPAY_KEY,
    "idempotency-key": crypto.randomUUID(),
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ productId: "my-app", planId: "pro",
                         provider: "paypal", email: "buyer@example.com" }),
});
const { checkoutUrl, reference } = await res.json();
```

प्रश्न

## आपके पूछने से पहले उत्तर

मैं कौन से भुगतान माध्यम स्वीकार कर सकता हूँ?

Paynow के माध्यम से EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari और ZimSwitch; अंतरराष्ट्रीय खरीदारों के लिए Visa, Mastercard और PayPal। 2Checkout बना हुआ है और प्रदाता द्वारा हमारा खाता स्वीकृत करते ही चालू हो जाएगा।

क्या आप मेरी बिक्री का प्रतिशत लेते हैं?

नहीं। योजनाएँ संसाधित भुगतानों पर आधारित निश्चित मासिक मूल्य हैं। भुगतान प्रदाता अपना शुल्क खुद लेते हैं।

क्या मैं असली पैसे के बिना परीक्षण कर सकता हूँ?

हाँ। पंजीकरण पर आपको सिम्युलेटर वाली परीक्षण कुंजी मिलती है। वह कभी किसी प्रदाता तक नहीं पहुँचती और आपकी योजना में नहीं गिनी जाती।

खरीदारों को लाइसेंस कैसे मिलता है?

भुगतान निपटते ही WavePay लाइसेंस कुंजी ईमेल करता है, और आपका ऐप हस्ताक्षरित अधिकार को ऑफ़लाइन सत्यापित कर सकता है।

क्या कोई AI एजेंट WavePay इस्तेमाल कर सकता है?

हाँ। उसे skill.md, OpenAPI दस्तावेज़ या MCP सर्वर की ओर इंगित करें। एजेंट बिना ब्राउज़र के पंजीकरण, मूल्य निर्धारण, चेकआउट और मिलान कर सकता है।

# WavePay — pembayaran dan lisensi untuk perangkat lunak

> Terima EcoCash, kartu, dan PayPal dengan satu API. Daftar dalam satu permintaan, uji dengan uang palsu, lalu aktifkan lisensi, langganan, dan pengembalian dana.

Kini dengan langganan, cicilan, dan 2Checkout

# Dapatkan bayaran untuk perangkat lunak Anda lewat *setiap metode yang dimiliki pembeli Anda*

Satu API untuk EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, ZimSwitch, kartu, dan PayPal. Daftar dalam satu permintaan, uji dengan uang palsu, lalu aktifkan dengan lisensi, langganan, dan pengembalian dana bawaan.

[Mulai gratis](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/pricing.html#register) [Baca dokumentasi](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html) [Untuk agen](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/skill.md)

- Paket gratis, tanpa kartu
- Tanpa biaya persentase atas penjualan Anda
- REST dan MCP

**9**metode pembayaran

**25**pembayaran gratis per bulan

**0%**biaya atas penjualan Anda

**15**bahasa

Metode pembayaran

## Setiap metode yang mungkin dimiliki pembeli

Dompet lokal untuk Zimbabwe, kartu dan PayPal untuk lainnya. Endpoint penyedia selalu menunjukkan apa yang aktif hari ini.

EcoCash OneMoney InnBucks Telecash O'mari ZimSwitch Visa Mastercard PayPal 2Checkout · segera hadir

Yang Anda dapatkan

## Checkout adalah bagian yang mudah. WavePay mengurus sisanya.

### Checkout terhosting dan dorongan dompet

Arahkan pembeli ke halaman terhosting, atau kirim permintaan EcoCash langsung ke ponsel mereka.

### Lisensi bawaan

Hak bertanda tangan, kunci lisensi lewat email, aktivasi perangkat, dan pemulihan. Aplikasi Anda memverifikasi secara luring.

### Langganan dan cicilan

Paket berulang, beli sekarang bayar nanti dengan kartu, dan masa tunggakan yang jelas sebelum akses berakhir.

### Pengembalian dana dan pembatalan

Pengembalian penuh dan sebagian lewat penyedia, dengan catatan siapa yang melakukannya dan mengapa.

### Lingkungan uji yang nyata

Kunci uji di samping kunci langsung, simulator, dan perjalanan waktu untuk melihat perpanjangan terjadi.

### Dibuat untuk agen

skill.md, OpenAPI, server MCP, dan alat WebMCP, sehingga AI dapat menyiapkan checkout untuk Anda.

Cara kerjanya

## Tiga permintaan dari nol hingga terbayar

1

### Daftar

Satu permintaan mengembalikan kunci langsung dan kunci uji. Paket gratis, langsung aktif.

2

### Jual

Buat checkout dan dapatkan URL terhosting, atau kirim permintaan dompet ke ponsel.

3

### Selesaikan

Webhook bertanda tangan atau polling mengonfirmasi uang masuk. Kunci lisensi dikirim otomatis lewat email.

Untuk pengembang

## Mulai dengan curl. Akhiri dengan kunci lisensi.

Setiap contoh dalam dokumentasi dijalankan lebih dulu di sandbox dengan kunci uji, sehingga Anda bisa mencoba dengan aman.

[Buka referensi API](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html)

curl MCP JavaScript

```
# 1. register: a live key and a test key, shown once 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/register \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"My App","ownerEmail":"you@example.com"}'

# 2. sell: returns a hosted checkout URL 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts \
  -H 'x-wavepay-service-key: mk_test_… ' \
  -H 'idempotency-key: order-1001' \
  -d '{"productId":"my-app","planId":"pro","provider":"paynow","email":"buyer@example.com"}'
```

```
# any MCP client: https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/mcp 
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "wavepay_checkout",
    "arguments": { "productId": "my-app", "planId": "pro",
                   "provider": "paynow", "email": "buyer@example.com" } } }

# tools: wavepay_register, wavepay_providers, wavepay_pricing,
#        wavepay_checkout, wavepay_checkout_status, wavepay_subscribe … 
```

```
const res = await fetch("https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "content-type": "application/json",
    "x-wavepay-service-key": process.env.WAVEPAY_KEY,
    "idempotency-key": crypto.randomUUID(),
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ productId: "my-app", planId: "pro",
                         provider: "paypal", email: "buyer@example.com" }),
});
const { checkoutUrl, reference } = await res.json();
```

Pertanyaan

## Jawaban sebelum Anda bertanya

Metode pembayaran apa yang bisa saya terima?

EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari, dan ZimSwitch lewat Paynow; Visa, Mastercard, dan PayPal untuk pembeli internasional. 2Checkout sudah dibangun dan akan aktif setelah penyedia menyetujui akun kami.

Apakah Anda mengambil persentase dari penjualan saya?

Tidak. Paket adalah harga bulanan tetap berdasarkan pembayaran yang diproses. Penyedia pembayaran mengenakan biayanya sendiri.

Bisakah saya menguji tanpa uang sungguhan?

Bisa. Pendaftaran memberi Anda kunci uji yang memakai simulator. Kunci itu tidak pernah menjangkau penyedia dan tidak dihitung dalam paket Anda.

Bagaimana pembeli mendapatkan lisensinya?

Saat pembayaran selesai, WavePay mengirim kunci lisensi lewat email, dan aplikasi Anda dapat memverifikasi hak bertanda tangan secara luring.

Bisakah agen AI menggunakan WavePay?

Bisa. Arahkan ke skill.md, dokumen OpenAPI, atau server MCP. Agen dapat mendaftar, menentukan harga, melakukan checkout, dan merekonsiliasi tanpa peramban.

# WavePay — checkout and licensing for software

> Take EcoCash, cards and PayPal with one API. Register in one request, test with fake money, then go live with licence keys, subscriptions and refunds.

Now with subscriptions, instalments and 2Checkout

# Get paid for your software on *every rail your buyers hold*

One API for EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, ZimSwitch, cards and PayPal. Register in one request, test with fake money, and go live with licence keys, subscriptions and refunds built in.

[Start free](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/pricing.html#register) [Read the docs](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html) [For agents](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/skill.md)

- Free plan, no card needed
- No percentage fee on your sales
- REST and MCP

**9**payment rails

**25**free payments a month

**0%**fee on your sales

**15**languages

Payment rails

## Every rail a buyer might hold

Local wallets for Zimbabwe, cards and PayPal for everyone else. The providers endpoint always says what is live today.

EcoCash OneMoney InnBucks Telecash O'mari ZimSwitch Visa Mastercard PayPal 2Checkout · coming soon

What you get

## Checkout is the easy part. WavePay is the rest of it.

### Hosted checkout and wallet push

Send buyers to a hosted page, or push an EcoCash prompt straight to their phone.

### Licensing built in

Signed entitlements, licence keys by email, device activation and recovery. Your app verifies offline.

### Subscriptions and instalments

Recurring plans, buy now pay later on cards, and a clear past-due period before access ends.

### Refunds and reversals

Full and partial refunds through the provider, with who did it and why on record.

### A real test environment

A test key beside your live key, a simulator, and time travel to watch a renewal happen.

### Built for agents

skill.md, OpenAPI, an MCP server and WebMCP tools, so an AI can set up checkout for you.

How it works

## Three requests from nothing to paid

1

### Register

One request returns a live key and a test key. Free plan, working immediately.

2

### Sell

Create a checkout and get a hosted URL, or push a wallet prompt to a phone.

3

### Settle

A signed webhook or a poll confirms the money. The licence key is emailed automatically.

For developers

## Start with curl. Finish with a licence key.

Every example in the documentation runs against the sandbox with a test key first, so you can break things safely.

[Open the API reference](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html)

curl MCP JavaScript

```
# 1. register: a live key and a test key, shown once 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/register \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"My App","ownerEmail":"you@example.com"}'

# 2. sell: returns a hosted checkout URL 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts \
  -H 'x-wavepay-service-key: mk_test_… ' \
  -H 'idempotency-key: order-1001' \
  -d '{"productId":"my-app","planId":"pro","provider":"paynow","email":"buyer@example.com"}'
```

```
# any MCP client: https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/mcp 
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "wavepay_checkout",
    "arguments": { "productId": "my-app", "planId": "pro",
                   "provider": "paynow", "email": "buyer@example.com" } } }

# tools: wavepay_register, wavepay_providers, wavepay_pricing,
#        wavepay_checkout, wavepay_checkout_status, wavepay_subscribe … 
```

```

  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "content-type": "application/json",
    "x-wavepay-service-key": process.env.WAVEPAY_KEY,
    "idempotency-key": crypto.randomUUID(),
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ productId: "my-app", planId: "pro",
                         provider: "paypal", email: "buyer@example.com" }),
});

```

Pricing

## Priced by payments, not by rake

Questions

## Answers before you ask

Which payment methods can I accept?

EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch through Paynow; Visa, Mastercard and PayPal for international buyers. 2Checkout is built and switches on when the provider approves our account.

Do you take a percentage of my sales?

No. Plans are flat monthly prices based on payments processed. The payment providers charge their own fees.

Can I test without real money?

Yes. Registration gives you a test key that uses a simulator. It never reaches a provider and never counts against your plan.

How do buyers get their licence?

When a payment settles, WavePay emails a licence key, and your app can verify the signed entitlement offline.

Can an AI agent use WavePay?

Yes. Point it at skill.md, the OpenAPI document or the MCP server. An agent can register, price, check out and reconcile without a browser.

# WavePay — pagamenti e licenze per il software

> Accetta EcoCash, carte e PayPal con una sola API. Registrati in una richiesta, prova con denaro finto e vai in produzione con licenze, abbonamenti e rimborsi.

Ora con abbonamenti, pagamenti rateali e 2Checkout

# Fatti pagare il tuo software su *ogni metodo che i tuoi clienti usano*

Una sola API per EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, ZimSwitch, carte e PayPal. Registrati in una richiesta, prova con denaro finto e vai live con licenze, abbonamenti e rimborsi già inclusi.

[Inizia gratis](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/pricing.html#register) [Leggi la documentazione](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html) [Per gli agenti](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/skill.md)

- Piano gratuito, senza carta
- Nessuna commissione percentuale sulle tue vendite
- REST e MCP

**9**metodi di pagamento

**25**pagamenti gratuiti al mese

**0%**di commissione sulle tue vendite

**15**lingue

Metodi di pagamento

## Ogni metodo che un acquirente può avere

Portafogli mobili locali per lo Zimbabwe, carte e PayPal per tutti gli altri. L'endpoint dei fornitori indica sempre cosa è attivo oggi.

EcoCash OneMoney InnBucks Telecash O'mari ZimSwitch Visa Mastercard PayPal 2Checkout · in arrivo

Cosa ottieni

## Il checkout è la parte facile. WavePay è tutto il resto.

### Checkout ospitato e richiesta al portafoglio

Manda gli acquirenti a una pagina ospitata, oppure invia una richiesta EcoCash direttamente al loro telefono.

### Licenze integrate

Diritti firmati, chiavi di licenza via e-mail, attivazione dei dispositivi e recupero. La tua app verifica offline.

### Abbonamenti e rate

Piani ricorrenti, paga dopo con carta e un periodo di ritardo chiaro prima che l'accesso termini.

### Rimborsi e storni

Rimborsi totali e parziali tramite il fornitore, con traccia di chi li ha fatti e perché.

### Un vero ambiente di prova

Una chiave di prova accanto a quella live, un simulatore e un viaggio nel tempo per vedere un rinnovo.

### Pensato per gli agenti

skill.md, OpenAPI, un server MCP e strumenti WebMCP: un'IA può configurare il checkout per te.

Come funziona

## Tre richieste da zero a pagato

1

### Registrati

Una richiesta restituisce una chiave live e una di prova. Piano gratuito, attivo subito.

2

### Vendi

Crea un checkout e ottieni un URL ospitato, oppure invia una richiesta a un telefono.

3

### Incassa

Un webhook firmato o un controllo conferma il denaro. La chiave di licenza arriva via e-mail in automatico.

Per gli sviluppatori

## Inizia con curl. Finisci con una chiave di licenza.

Ogni esempio della documentazione gira prima nella sandbox con una chiave di prova, così puoi sbagliare senza rischi.

[Apri il riferimento API](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html)

curl MCP JavaScript

```
# 1. register: a live key and a test key, shown once 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/register \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"My App","ownerEmail":"you@example.com"}'

# 2. sell: returns a hosted checkout URL 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts \
  -H 'x-wavepay-service-key: mk_test_… ' \
  -H 'idempotency-key: order-1001' \
  -d '{"productId":"my-app","planId":"pro","provider":"paynow","email":"buyer@example.com"}'
```

```
# any MCP client: https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/mcp 
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "wavepay_checkout",
    "arguments": { "productId": "my-app", "planId": "pro",
                   "provider": "paynow", "email": "buyer@example.com" } } }

# tools: wavepay_register, wavepay_providers, wavepay_pricing,
#        wavepay_checkout, wavepay_checkout_status, wavepay_subscribe … 
```

```
const res = await fetch("https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "content-type": "application/json",
    "x-wavepay-service-key": process.env.WAVEPAY_KEY,
    "idempotency-key": crypto.randomUUID(),
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ productId: "my-app", planId: "pro",
                         provider: "paypal", email: "buyer@example.com" }),
});
const { checkoutUrl, reference } = await res.json();
```

Domande

## Risposte prima che tu chieda

Quali metodi di pagamento posso accettare?

EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari e ZimSwitch tramite Paynow; Visa, Mastercard e PayPal per gli acquirenti internazionali. 2Checkout è pronto e si attiva quando il fornitore approverà il nostro account.

Prendete una percentuale sulle mie vendite?

No. I piani sono prezzi mensili fissi in base ai pagamenti elaborati. I fornitori di pagamento applicano le proprie commissioni.

Posso provare senza denaro reale?

Sì. La registrazione ti dà una chiave di prova che usa un simulatore. Non raggiunge mai un fornitore e non conta nel tuo piano.

Come ricevono la licenza gli acquirenti?

Quando un pagamento è regolato, WavePay invia una chiave di licenza via e-mail e la tua app può verificare offline il diritto firmato.

Un agente IA può usare WavePay?

Sì. Indicagli skill.md, il documento OpenAPI o il server MCP. Un agente può registrarsi, fissare i prezzi, incassare e riconciliare senza browser.

# WavePay — ソフトウェアの決済とライセンス

> 1つのAPIでEcoCash、カード、PayPalに対応。1回のリクエストで登録し、擬似資金でテストして、ライセンス・定期課金・返金とともに本番へ。

定期課金、分割払い、2Checkoutに対応しました

# あなたのソフトウェアの代金を *購入者が持つあらゆる決済手段で受け取る*

EcoCash、OneMoney、InnBucks、ZimSwitch、カード、PayPalを1つのAPIで。1回のリクエストで登録し、擬似資金でテストし、ライセンス・定期課金・返金が組み込まれた状態で本番へ。

[無料で始める](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/pricing.html#register) [ドキュメントを読む](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html) [エージェント向け](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/skill.md)

- 無料プラン、カード不要
- 売上に対する手数料なし
- RESTとMCP

**9**種類の決済手段

**25**毎月の無料決済数

**0%**売上にかかる手数料

**15**言語

決済手段

## 購入者が持ちうるあらゆる手段に対応

ジンバブエ向けの現地ウォレットと、それ以外の地域向けのカードおよびPayPal。プロバイダーのエンドポイントで、現在有効な手段をいつでも確認できます。

EcoCash OneMoney InnBucks Telecash O'mari ZimSwitch Visa Mastercard PayPal 2Checkout · 近日対応

できること

## 決済は簡単な部分です。残りはWavePayが担います。

### ホスト型チェックアウトとウォレット請求

購入者をホスト型ページへ誘導するか、EcoCashの請求を直接スマートフォンへ送信します。

### ライセンス管理を内蔵

署名付き権利、メールでのライセンスキー送付、デバイス認証と復旧。アプリはオフラインで検証できます。

### 定期課金と分割払い

継続課金プラン、カードでの後払い、アクセス終了前の明確な猶予期間。

### 返金と取消

プロバイダー経由で全額・一部返金を行い、誰がなぜ実施したかを記録します。

### 本物のテスト環境

本番キーの隣にテストキー、シミュレーター、そして更新を確認できるタイムトラベル機能。

### エージェント向けに設計

skill.md、OpenAPI、MCPサーバー、WebMCPツールにより、AIがチェックアウトを設定できます。

仕組み

## 3回のリクエストで、ゼロから入金まで

1

### 登録

1回のリクエストで本番キーとテストキーが返ります。無料プランですぐに利用できます。

2

### 販売

チェックアウトを作成してホスト型URLを取得するか、スマートフォンへウォレット請求を送ります。

3

### 精算

署名付きWebhookまたはポーリングで入金を確認し、ライセンスキーは自動でメール送信されます。

開発者向け

## curlで始めて、ライセンスキーで終える。

ドキュメントのすべての例は、まずテストキーを使ってサンドボックスで動作するため、安心して試せます。

[APIリファレンスを開く](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html)

```

```

```

{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "wavepay_checkout",
    "arguments": { "productId": "my-app", "planId": "pro",
```

```
    "idempotency-key": crypto.randomUUID(),

  body: JSON.stringify({ productId: "my-app", planId: "pro",
                         provider: "paypal", email: "buyer@example.com" }),
```

よくある質問

## 聞かれる前にお答えします

どの決済手段を受け付けられますか？

Paynow経由でEcoCash、OneMoney、InnBucks、Telecash、O'mari、ZimSwitch。海外の購入者向けにVisa、Mastercard、PayPal。2Checkoutは開発済みで、プロバイダーによるアカウント承認後に有効化されます。

売上の何パーセントかを受け取りますか？

いいえ。処理した決済件数に基づく月額固定のプランです。決済プロバイダーは独自の手数料を請求します。

本物のお金なしでテストできますか？

はい。登録するとシミュレーターを使うテストキーが発行されます。プロバイダーには届かず、プランの件数にも数えられません。

購入者はどうやってライセンスを受け取りますか？

決済が完了すると、WavePayがライセンスキーをメールで送信し、アプリは署名付き権利をオフラインで検証できます。

AIエージェントはWavePayを使えますか？

はい。skill.md、OpenAPIドキュメント、MCPサーバーを案内してください。エージェントはブラウザなしで登録、価格設定、決済、照合ができます。

# WavePay — inkokhelo lamalayisense ezinhlelo

> Samukela i-EcoCash, amakhadi le-PayPal nge-API eyodwa. Bhalisa ngesicelo esisodwa, linga ngemali yokulingisa, uqale ngamalayisense lokubuyisela imali.

Manje lokukhokha ngezikhathi, ngezigaba le-2Checkout

# Khokhelwa izinhlelo zakho nge *yonke indlela abathengi bakho abayisebenzisayo*

I-API eyodwa ye-EcoCash, i-OneMoney, i-InnBucks, i-ZimSwitch, amakhadi le-PayPal. Bhalisa ngesicelo esisodwa, linga ngemali yokulingisa, bese uqala ngamalayisense, ukukhokha ngezikhathi lokubuyisela imali okufakiwe.

[Qala mahala](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/pricing.html#register) [Funda imibhalo](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html) [Kuma-ejenti](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/skill.md)

- Uhlelo lwamahala, akukho khadi elidingekayo

Izindlela zokukhokha

## Zonke izindlela umthengi angaba lazo

Izikhwama zasekhaya zeZimbabwe, amakhadi le-PayPal kwabanye. Indawo yabahlinzeki ihlala itshengisa okusebenzayo namuhla.

EcoCash OneMoney InnBucks Telecash O'mari ZimSwitch Visa Mastercard PayPal 2Checkout · kuyeza

Okuzakuthola

## Ukukhokha yikhona okulula. I-WavePay yikho konke okuseleyo.

### Ikhasi lokukhokha lesicelo sesikhwama

Thumela abathengi ekhasini lokukhokha, loba uthumele isicelo se-EcoCash ngqo efoyinini labo.

### Amalayisense akhelwe ngaphakathi

Amalungelo asayiniwe, okhiye bamalayisense nge-imeyili, ukusebenzisa amadivayisi lokubuyiselwa. I-app yakho iyahlola ingelayo i-inthanethi.

### Ukukhokha ngezikhathi langezigaba

Izinhlelo eziphindaphindwayo, thenga manje ukhokhe emva kwesikhathi ngekhadi, lesikhathi esicacileyo sokubambezela ukufinyelela kungakapheli.

### Ukubuyisela imali lokuhlehlisa

Ukubuyisela imali yonke loba ingxenye ngomhlinzeki, lerekhodi lokuthi ngubani owakwenzayo lesizatho.

### Indawo yangempela yokulinga

Ukhiye wokulinga eduze kokhiye wakho wangempela, i-simulator, lokuhamba kwesikhathi ukubona ukuvuselelwa.

### Yakhelwe ama-ejenti

I-skill.md, i-OpenAPI, iseva ye-MCP lamathuluzi e-WebMCP, ukuze i-AI ikulungisele ukukhokha.

Isebenza njani

## Izicelo ezintathu ukusuka kunalutho kuze kube khokhelwe

1

### Bhalisa

Isicelo esisodwa sibuyisa ukhiye wangempela lokhiye wokulinga. Uhlelo lwamahala, lusebenza ngokuphangisa.

2

### Thengisa

Dala ukukhokha uthole i-URL yekhasi, loba uthumele isicelo sesikhwama efoyinini.

3

### Qedisa

I-webhook esayiniwe loba ukubuzisisa kuqinisekisa imali. Ukhiye welayisense uthunyelwa ngokuzenzakalelayo nge-imeyili.

Kubakhi

## Qala nge-curl. Qeda ngokhiye welayisense.

Isibonelo ngasinye semibhalo siqala sisebenze endaweni yokulinga ngokhiye wokulinga, ukuze ulingeke uphephile.

[Vula isalathiso se-API](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html)

curl MCP JavaScript

```
# 1. register: a live key and a test key, shown once 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/register \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"My App","ownerEmail":"you@example.com"}'

# 2. sell: returns a hosted checkout URL 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts \
  -H 'x-wavepay-service-key: mk_test_… ' \
  -H 'idempotency-key: order-1001' \
  -d '{"productId":"my-app","planId":"pro","provider":"paynow","email":"buyer@example.com"}'
```

```
# any MCP client: https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/mcp 
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "wavepay_checkout",
    "arguments": { "productId": "my-app", "planId": "pro",
                   "provider": "paynow", "email": "buyer@example.com" } } }

# tools: wavepay_register, wavepay_providers, wavepay_pricing,
#        wavepay_checkout, wavepay_checkout_status, wavepay_subscribe … 
```

```
const res = await fetch("https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "content-type": "application/json",
    "x-wavepay-service-key": process.env.WAVEPAY_KEY,
    "idempotency-key": crypto.randomUUID(),
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ productId: "my-app", planId: "pro",
                         provider: "paypal", email: "buyer@example.com" }),
});
const { checkoutUrl, reference } = await res.json();
```

Imibuzo

## Izimpendulo ungakabuzi

Ngingasamukela zimuphi izindlela zokukhokha?

I-EcoCash, i-OneMoney, i-InnBucks, i-Telecash, i-O'mari le-ZimSwitch nge-Paynow; i-Visa, i-Mastercard le-PayPal kubathengi bamazwe angaphandle. I-2Checkout yakhiwe izavulwa lapho umhlinzeki evuma i-akhawunti yethu.

Niyathatha ipesenti yokuthengisa kwami yini?

Hatshi. Izinhlelo zintengo zenyanga ezimisiweyo ngokuya ngezinkokhelo ezilungisiweyo. Abahlinzeki bokukhokha bakhokhisa izimali zabo.

Ngingalinga ngaphandle kwemali yangempela yini?

Yebo. Ukubhalisa kukunika ukhiye wokulinga osebenzisa i-simulator. Kawufinyeleli kumhlinzeki kawubalwa kuhlelo lwakho.

Abathengi bayitholaphi ilayisense yabo?

Lapho inkokhelo isiphelile, i-WavePay ithumela ukhiye welayisense nge-imeyili, ne-app yakho ingahlola ilungelo elisayiniweyo ingelayo i-inthanethi.

I-ejenti ye-AI ingasebenzisa i-WavePay yini?

Yebo. Yikhombise i-skill.md, imibhalo ye-OpenAPI loba iseva ye-MCP. I-ejenti ingabhalisa, ibeke intengo, ikhokhise iqathanise ingelayo isiphequluli.

> Charge for an API with WavePay by selling plans through checkout, issuing a licence key on payment, and gating requests on the key — settlement arrives by signed…

USE CASE

# How to charge for API access

Charge for an API with WavePay by selling plans through checkout, issuing a licence key on payment, and gating requests on the key — settlement arrives by signed webhook so access can be granted automatically.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth: 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month

## The flow

1. Sell: a checkout per plan with POST /v2/checkouts.
2. Issue: the paid checkout emails the licence key; activation returns a signed entitlement.
3. Gate: your API checks the entitlement or key before serving a request.
4. Automate: register a webhook with POST /v2/internal/sites/webhook; the HMAC secret is returned once.

## Questions

## How does my API learn that someone paid?

Through a signed webhook, or by polling checkout status.

## Is the webhook authentic?

Settlements are signed with the HMAC secret returned when you registered the webhook.
